verses.original: וַ֭יַּעַן צֹפַ֥ר הַנַּֽעֲמָתִ֗י וַיֹּאמַֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘an ṣō·p̄ar han·na·‘ă·mā·ṯî way·yō·mar
verses.literal: Then Zophar the Naamathite . . . replied

verses.original: לָ֭כֵן שְׂעִפַּ֣י יְשִׁיב֑וּנִי וּ֝בַעֲב֗וּר ח֣וּשִׁי בִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên śə·‘ip·pay yə·šî·ḇū·nî ū·ḇa·‘ă·ḇūr ḥū·šî ḇî
verses.literal: So my anxious thoughts compel me to answer because of the turmoil within me

verses.original: מוּסַ֣ר כְּלִמָּתִ֣י אֶשְׁמָ֑ע וְ֝ר֗וּחַ מִֽבִּינָתִ֥י יַעֲנֵֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: mū·sar kə·lim·mā·ṯî ’eš·mā‘ wə·rū·aḥ mib·bî·nā·ṯî ya·‘ă·nê·nî
verses.literal: I have heard . . . a rebuke that insults me and my understanding prompts a reply

verses.original: הֲזֹ֣את יָ֭דַעְתָּ מִנִּי־ עַ֑ד מִנִּ֤י שִׂ֖ים אָדָ֣ם עֲלֵי־ אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: hă·zōṯ yā·ḏa‘·tā min·nî- ‘aḏ min·nî śîm ’ā·ḏām ‘ă·lê- ’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: Do you not know that from antiquity since man was placed on the earth

verses.original: כִּ֤י רִנְנַ֣ת רְ֭שָׁעִים מִקָּר֑וֹב וְשִׂמְחַ֖ת חָנֵ֣ף עֲדֵי־ רָֽגַע׃
verses.transliteration: kî rin·naṯ rə·šā·‘îm miq·qā·rō·wḇ wə·śim·ḥaṯ ḥā·nêp̄ ‘ă·ḏê- rā·ḡa‘
verses.literal: the triumph of the wicked has been brief and the joy of the godless momentary

verses.original: אִם־ יַעֲלֶ֣ה לַשָּׁמַ֣יִם שִׂיא֑וֹ וְ֝רֹאשׁ֗וֹ לָעָ֥ב יַגִּֽיעַ׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- ya·‘ă·leh laš·šā·ma·yim śî·’ōw wə·rō·šōw lā·‘āḇ yag·gî·a‘
verses.literal: Though his arrogance reaches the heavens and his head touches the clouds

verses.original: כְּֽ֭גֶלֲלוֹ לָנֶ֣צַח יֹאבֵ֑ד רֹ֝אָ֗יו יֹאמְר֥וּ אַיּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: kə·ḡe·lă·lōw lā·ne·ṣaḥ yō·ḇêḏ rō·’āw yō·mə·rū ’ay·yōw
verses.literal: he will perish forever like his own dung those who had seen him will ask Where is he

verses.original: כַּחֲל֣וֹם יָ֭עוּף וְלֹ֣א יִמְצָא֑וּהוּ וְ֝יֻדַּ֗ד כְּחֶזְי֥וֹן לָֽיְלָה׃
verses.transliteration: ka·ḥă·lō·wm yā·‘ūp̄ wə·lō yim·ṣā·’ū·hū wə·yud·daḏ kə·ḥez·yō·wn lā·yə·lāh
verses.literal: He will fly away like a dream never to be found he will be chased away like a vision in the night

verses.original: עַ֣יִן שְׁ֭זָפַתּוּ וְלֹ֣א תוֹסִ֑יף וְלֹא־ ע֝֗וֹד תְּשׁוּרֶ֥נּוּ מְקוֹמֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ‘a·yin šə·zā·p̲at·tû wə·lō ṯō·w·sîp̄ wə·lō- ‘ō·wḏ tə·šū·ren·nū mə·qō·w·mōw
verses.literal: The eye that saw him will see him no more and his place will no longer behold him

verses.original: בָּ֭נָיו יְרַצּ֣וּ דַלִּ֑ים וְ֝יָדָ֗יו תָּשֵׁ֥בְנָה אוֹנֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: bā·nāw yə·raṣ·ṣū ḏal·lîm wə·yā·ḏāw tā·šê·ḇə·nāh ’ō·w·nōw
verses.literal: His sons will seek the favor of the poor for his own hands must return his wealth

verses.original: עַ֭צְמוֹתָיו מָלְא֣וּ עֲלוּמוֹ וְ֝עִמּ֗וֹ עַל־ עָפָ֥ר תִּשְׁכָּֽב׃
verses.transliteration: ‘aṣ·mō·w·ṯāw mā·lə·’ū ʿă·lū·mō wə·‘im·mōw ‘al- ‘ā·p̄ār tiš·kāḇ
verses.literal: The youthful vigor that fills his bones will lie down with him in the dust

verses.original: אִם־ תַּמְתִּ֣יק בְּפִ֣יו רָעָ֑ה יַ֝כְחִידֶ֗נָּה תַּ֣חַת לְשׁוֹנֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- tam·tîq bə·p̄îw rā·‘āh yaḵ·ḥî·ḏen·nāh ta·ḥaṯ lə·šō·w·nōw
verses.literal: Though evil is sweet in his mouth and he conceals it under his tongue

verses.original: יַחְמֹ֣ל עָ֭לֶיהָ וְלֹ֣א יַֽעַזְבֶ֑נָּה וְ֝יִמְנָעֶ֗נָּה בְּת֣וֹךְ חִכּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: yaḥ·mōl ‘ā·le·hā wə·lō ya·‘az·ḇen·nāh wə·yim·nā·‘en·nāh bə·ṯō·wḵ ḥik·kōw
verses.literal: though he cannot bear . . . . . . to let it go and keeps it in his mouth

verses.original: לַ֭חְמוֹ בְּמֵעָ֣יו נֶהְפָּ֑ךְ מְרוֹרַ֖ת פְּתָנִ֣ים בְּקִרְבּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: laḥ·mōw bə·mê·‘āw neh·pāḵ mə·rō·w·raṯ pə·ṯā·nîm bə·qir·bōw
verses.literal: yet in his stomach his food sours into the venom of cobras within him

verses.original: חַ֣יִל בָּ֭לַע וַיְקִאֶ֑נּוּ מִ֝בִּטְנ֗וֹ יוֹרִשֶׁ֥נּוּ אֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: ḥa·yil bā·la‘ way·qi·’en·nū mib·biṭ·nōw yō·w·ri·šen·nū ’êl
verses.literal: He swallows wealth but vomits it out God will force it from his stomach

verses.original: רֹאשׁ־ פְּתָנִ֥ים יִינָ֑ק תַּֽ֝הַרְגֵ֗הוּ לְשׁ֣וֹן אֶפְעֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: rōš- pə·ṯā·nîm yî·nāq ta·har·ḡê·hū lə·šō·wn ’ep̄·‘eh
verses.literal: He will suck the poison of cobras the fangs of a viper will kill him

verses.original: אַל־ יֵ֥רֶא בִפְלַגּ֑וֹת נַהֲרֵ֥י נַ֝חֲלֵ֗י דְּבַ֣שׁ וְחֶמְאָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- yê·re ḇip̄·lag·gō·wṯ na·hă·rê na·ḥă·lê də·ḇaš wə·ḥem·’āh
verses.literal: He will not enjoy the streams the rivers flowing with honey and cream

verses.original: מֵשִׁ֣יב יָ֭גָע וְלֹ֣א יִבְלָ֑ע כְּחֵ֥יל תְּ֝מוּרָת֗וֹ וְלֹ֣א יַעֲלֹֽס׃
verses.transliteration: mê·šîḇ yā·ḡā‘ wə·lō yiḇ·lā‘ kə·ḥêl tə·mū·rā·ṯōw wə·lō ya·‘ă·lōs
verses.literal: He must return the fruit of his labor without consuming it he cannot enjoy the profits of his trading

verses.original: כִּֽי־ רִ֭צַּץ עָזַ֣ב דַּלִּ֑ים בַּ֥יִת גָּ֝זַ֗ל וְלֹ֣א יִבֶנֵֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- riṣ·ṣaṣ ‘ā·zaḇ dal·lîm ba·yiṯ gā·zal wə·lō yi·ḇe·nê·hū
verses.literal: For he has oppressed and forsaken the poor he has seized houses he did not build

verses.original: כִּ֤י׀ לֹא־ יָדַ֣ע שָׁלֵ֣ו בְּבִטְנ֑וֹ בַּ֝חֲמוּד֗וֹ לֹ֣א יְמַלֵּֽט׃
verses.transliteration: kî lō- yā·ḏa‘ šā·lêw bə·ḇiṭ·nōw ba·ḥă·mū·ḏōw lō yə·mal·lêṭ
verses.literal: Because his appetite is never satisfied . . . he cannot escape with his treasure

verses.original: אֵין־ שָׂרִ֥יד לְאָכְל֑וֹ עַל־ כֵּ֝֗ן לֹא־ יָחִ֥יל טוּבֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ên- śā·rîḏ lə·’ā·ḵə·lōw ‘al- kên lō- yā·ḥîl ṭū·ḇōw
verses.literal: Nothing is left for him to consume thus . . . his prosperity will not endure

verses.original: בִּמְלֹ֣אות שִׂ֭פְקוֹ יֵ֣צֶר ל֑וֹ כָּל־ יַ֖ד עָמֵ֣ל תְּבוֹאֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.transliteration: bim·lō·wṯ śip̲·qô yê·ṣer lōw kāl- yaḏ ‘ā·mêl tə·ḇō·w·’en·nū
verses.literal: In the midst of his plenty he will be distressed the full force of misery will come upon him

verses.original: יְהִ֤י׀ לְמַלֵּ֬א בִטְנ֗וֹ יְֽשַׁלַּח־ בּ֭וֹ חֲר֣וֹן אַפּ֑וֹ וְיַמְטֵ֥ר עָ֝לֵ֗ימוֹ בִּלְחוּמֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: yə·hî lə·mal·lê ḇiṭ·nōw yə·šal·laḥ- bōw ḥă·rō·wn ’ap·pōw wə·yam·ṭêr ‘ā·lê·mōw bil·ḥū·mōw
verses.literal: When he has filled his stomach God will vent His fury . . . upon him raining it down on him as he eats

verses.original: יִ֭בְרַח מִנֵּ֣שֶׁק בַּרְזֶ֑ל תַּ֝חְלְפֵ֗הוּ קֶ֣שֶׁת נְחוּשָֽׁה׃
verses.transliteration: yiḇ·raḥ min·nê·šeq bar·zel taḥ·lə·p̄ê·hū qe·šeṯ nə·ḥū·šāh
verses.literal: Though he flees from an iron weapon a bronze-tipped arrow will pierce him

verses.original: שָׁלַף֮ וַיֵּצֵ֪א מִגֵּ֫וָ֥ה וּ֭בָרָק מִֽמְּרֹרָת֥וֹ יַהֲלֹ֗ךְ עָלָ֥יו אֵמִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: šā·lap̄ way·yê·ṣê mig·gê·wāh ū·ḇā·rāq mim·mə·rō·rā·ṯōw ya·hă·lōḵ ‘ā·lāw ’ê·mîm
verses.literal: It is drawn out of his back the gleaming point from his liver Terrors come over him

verses.original: כָּל־ חֹשֶׁךְ֮ טָמ֪וּן לִצְפּ֫וּנָ֥יו תְּ֭אָכְלֵהוּ אֵ֣שׁ לֹֽא־ נֻפָּ֑ח יֵ֖רַע שָׂרִ֣יד בְּאָהֳלֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- ḥō·šeḵ ṭā·mūn liṣ·pū·nāw tə·’ā·ḵə·lê·hū ’êš lō- nup·pāḥ yê·ra‘ śā·rîḏ bə·’ā·ho·lōw
verses.literal: Total darkness is reserved for his treasures A fire unfanned . . . . . . will consume him and devour what is left in his tent

verses.original: יְגַלּ֣וּ שָׁמַ֣יִם עֲוֺנ֑וֹ וְ֝אֶ֗רֶץ מִתְקוֹמָ֘מָ֥ה לֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: yə·ḡal·lū šā·ma·yim ‘ă·wō·nōw wə·’e·reṣ miṯ·qō·w·mā·māh lōw
verses.literal: The heavens will expose his iniquity and the earth will rise up against him

verses.original: יִ֭גֶל יְב֣וּל בֵּית֑וֹ נִ֝גָּר֗וֹת בְּי֣וֹם אַפּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: yi·ḡel yə·ḇūl bê·ṯōw nig·gā·rō·wṯ bə·yō·wm ’ap·pōw
verses.literal: The possessions of his house will be removed flowing away on the day of God’s wrath

verses.original: זֶ֤ה׀ חֵֽלֶק־ אָדָ֣ם רָ֭שָׁע מֵאֱלֹהִ֑ים וְנַחֲלַ֖ת אִמְר֣וֹ מֵאֵֽל׃פ
verses.transliteration: zeh ḥê·leq- ’ā·ḏām rā·šā‘ mê·’ĕ·lō·hîm wə·na·ḥă·laṯ ’im·rōw mê·’êl
verses.literal: This is the wicked man’s portion from God the inheritance God has appointed him
